description: This file defines the PromiseInterface interface which specifies the methods for handling asynchronous promise objects in the GuzzleHttp Promises library. It includes constants for promise states and methods for resolving, rejecting, and waiting on promises, as well as attaching callbacks.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Registers fulfillment and rejection handlers, returning a new promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Registers a rejection handler callback, returning a new promise.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise ('pending', 'fulfilled', or 'rejected').

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a given reason.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the promise if possible.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the promise to complete, optionally unwrapping the result or throwing an exception.
